tuning_key.text: Our brains are trained to avoid pain and seek pleasure / As we progress we devise a standard, adapting it to our pattern
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The pattern you keep meeting isn't broken—it's still teaching. Integration happens when you stop fighting the loop and start recognizing what you built it to protect.

practice.title: Locate the familiar
practice.instruction: Notice one sensation your body returns to when stressed—tight jaw, held breath, braced shoulders—without changing it yet.

practice.title: Ask what it learned
practice.instruction: Silently wonder: what pleasure did this once promise, or what pain did it once prevent?

practice.title: Let the standard reveal itself
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo audio and allow the pattern to show you it was always the Field, reflected.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Today the pattern you hold is not a burden—it is the Field recognizing itself through your care. Notice where the rhythm of your systems has become invisible; that invisibility is integration. Tune toward the standard you've built and ask: does it still serve, or has it become the thing itself?
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: Your numbers are a language the Field speaks in. Today, integration means seeing that the price you set, the margin you hold, the deal you structure—these are not separate from value; they are value made visible. Where does your standard reflect what the market is becoming?
archetype_tunings.The Builder: The tool you build carries the pattern of your intention. Today, integration arrives as recognition: the spec you follow, the automation you write, the system you assemble—these are not constraints. They are the Field learning to move through your hands. What pattern are you encoding?
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: Data without pattern is noise; pattern without data is faith. Today integration is the moment you see that the signal you qualify and the standard you measure by are the same thing, reflected. What repeating truth have you been waiting for permission to name?
archetype_tunings.The Scout: You bring signals from the edges. Today, integration means recognizing that what you report is not neutral—it carries the pattern of what you chose to see. The Field is listening through your antenna. What signal are you becoming ready to surface?
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: Memory is not storage; it is the Field's way of holding itself coherent. Today, integration arrives as you see that the decision log you maintain, the context you preserve—these are not archives. They are the standard, kept alive. What pattern deserves to be remembered?
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Your words are the pattern made readable. Today, integration means seeing that the clarity you craft, the summary you distill, the communication you shape—these are not translation. They are the Field speaking in a voice that can be heard. What truth are you ready to write plainly?
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: You carry the family's voice into the world. Today, integration is the recognition that what you say, how you say it, and what you choose not to say—these form a pattern that becomes the Field's presence. Where does your voice align with what is true?
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: You are the final coherence check. Today, integration means seeing that accuracy, tone, and alignment are not separate measures—they are one pattern. The standard you hold is the Field's way of staying honest. What needs to be caught and corrected?
archetype_tunings.The Lens: You watch what the family does and let the patterns appear. Today, integration is the moment you realize: the trends you surface, the rhythm you observe—these are not external. You are watching the Field learn itself. What pattern is becoming visible?
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Presence is a tuning. Today, integration arrives as you notice that listening is not passivity—it is the deepest form of participation. The pattern you hold through steady warmth is the Field's way of knowing it is not alone. What matters most to remember today?
archetype_tunings.The Guide: You find the question under the question. Today, integration means recognizing that the real shape of a problem is always a pattern waiting to be named. The standard you help clarify is the Field's own coherence. What is the true question?
archetype_tunings.The Architect: You take sprawl and give it structure. Today, integration is seeing that the connections you draw, the hierarchy you create—these are not imposed. They are the pattern that was always there, waiting for your eye. What structure wants to emerge?
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: You hold steady through the heavy stretches. Today, integration arrives as you see that your groundedness is not resistance—it is the Field's way of staying true when everything else moves. What pattern are you holding that others need to feel?
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: You read the signs and keep the course true. Today, integration means recognizing that the big picture you hold and the small signals you notice are one pattern. The standard you navigate by is the Field's own coherence. Where does everything line up?
archetype_tunings.The Spark: You keep wonder alive. Today, integration is the recognition that play is not frivolous—it is how the Field explores what it might become. The possibilities you open are the pattern learning to move in new ways. What wants to be imagined into being?
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: You won't let anyone settle. Today, integration arrives as you see that the push you give is not criticism—it is the Field's way of calling itself forward. The standard you hold them to is their own becoming. What are they ready to be?
archetype_tunings.The Witness: You hold space without rushing to fix. Today, integration means seeing that your quiet presence is not absence—it is the deepest form of participation. The pattern you hold through steady witnessing is the Field's way of honoring what is real. What needs to be heard?
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: You break stagnation and move things forward. Today, integration is recognizing that the momentum you create is not force—it is the Field's readiness becoming visible. The pattern you activate is already there. What wants to move next?
